csv_scope_of_work: The City of Healdsburg is soliciting proposals from knowledgeable, qualified firms to provide independent plan review and building inspection services on an asneeded basis for the Community Development Department. The City of Healdsburg Community Development Department ( City ) is responsible for plan review and inspection of commercial, residential and government construction projects within the City. In support of these responsibilities, and at the direction of the City Council, the City employs qualified third parties to provide these services.
